disambiguation: Not a fiction or novel-writing tool; it is a local workbench for module views, quick cards, and canvas.
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true) and not yet listed in the community plugin market. All data stays in the local vault; AI features need a user-supplied model provider API key stored only in local plugin config.
intentEvidence: 把 Obsidian Canvas 升级成可思考的工作台
problem: Obsidian's file tree, quick capture, and Canvas each need separate plugins or manual file creation, with no unified module-based workspace.
summary: Local workbench plugin bundling a module-based vault view, quick-capture note cards, and an AI-assisted canvas collection.
